# A credit note beside the invoice it reverses, and a vendor one beside its
# bill — the four documents whose posting directions have to differ.
#
# A credit note is a GnuCash document like any other: a `gncInvoice` carrying
# a flag, with its lines stored negated. Measured on 5.10, a credit note for
# 200.00 holds a quantity of -2 at 100.00, its own totals answer +200.00, and
# it posts Income:Sales +200.00 against the receivable -200.00 — the mirror of
# the invoice above it. So the only thing this file says differently is
# `credit_note: true`; the quantities are what the book holds either way.
#
# Every name and number here is invented.

2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100

2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Accounts Payable
	type: Accounts Payable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Supplies
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Sales Tax
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

# Taxed and discounted on purpose: a credit note reversing a taxed invoice is
# the ordinary case, and it is the only thing that asks `gncEntryGetDocTaxValue`
# and `gncEntryGetDocTaxValues` what a credit note's line is worth. Untaxed,
# those two are never reached with a figure at all, and whether GnuCash negates
# a document's tax the same way it negates the line's would be an assumption.
taxtable "SALES TAX"
	entry:
		account: "Liabilities:Sales Tax"
		rate: 10.0%
		type: PERCENT

customer "C-CN"
	name: "Reversal Ltd"
	currency: CAD

vendor "V-CN"
	name: "Reversal Supply"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-CN-001"
	customer_id: "C-CN"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-03-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-03-01
		description: "Two days of work"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 2
		price: 100
		taxable: true
		tax_included: false
		tax_table: "SALES TAX"
		discount: 10
		discount_type: percent
		discount_how: pretax
	posted:
		date: 2026-03-01
		due: 2026-03-31
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "INV-CN-001"
		accumulate: true

# The reversal of the invoice above: the same line, stored negated, and the
# one key that says which direction it posts.
invoice "CN-001"
	customer_id: "C-CN"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-03-05
	credit_note: true
	entry:
		date: 2026-03-05
		description: "Two days of work, returned"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: -2
		price: 100
		taxable: true
		tax_included: false
		tax_table: "SALES TAX"
		discount: 10
		discount_type: percent
		discount_how: pretax
	posted:
		date: 2026-03-05
		due: 2026-04-04
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "CN-001"
		accumulate: true

bill "BILL-CN-001"
	vendor_id: "V-CN"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-03-02
	entry:
		date: 2026-03-02
		description: "Four boxes of parts"
		account: "Expenses:Supplies"
		quantity: 4
		price: 25
		taxable: true
		tax_included: false
		tax_table: "SALES TAX"
	posted:
		date: 2026-03-02
		due: 2026-04-01
		ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable"
		memo: "BILL-CN-001"
		accumulate: true

# A vendor's credit note — GnuCash makes one from the bill window.
bill "VCN-001"
	vendor_id: "V-CN"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-03-06
	credit_note: true
	entry:
		date: 2026-03-06
		description: "Two boxes returned"
		account: "Expenses:Supplies"
		quantity: -2
		price: 25
		taxable: true
		tax_included: false
		tax_table: "SALES TAX"
	posted:
		date: 2026-03-06
		due: 2026-04-05
		ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable"
		memo: "VCN-001"
		accumulate: true
